cohort: Singleton live births at a hospital in Bursa, Turkey, between June 1 and December 31, 2015 (545 Syrian refugees and 545 Turkish citizens)
finding: Cesarean delivery was more common among Turkish citizens than Syrian refugees, with other notable differences in birth characteristics observed between the groups.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was more common among Turkish citizens (43.1%) than among Syrian refugees (32.3%).
birth_weight: Median neonatal birth weight was higher among Turkish citizens (3300 g) than among Syrian refugees (3110 g).
